verses.en: Praise ye the LORD. Praise the LORD, O my soul.
verses.pt: Louvai ao Senhor.Ó minha alma, louva ao Senhor.
verses.en_web: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh, my soul.
verses.en_bbe: Let the Lord be praised. Give praise to the Lord, O my soul.

verses.en: While I live will I praise the LORD: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.
verses.pt: Louvarei ao Senhor durante a minha vida; cantarei louvores ao meu Deus enquanto viver.
verses.en_web: While I live, I will praise Yahweh. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.
verses.en_bbe: While I have breath I will give praise to the Lord: I will make melody to my God while I have my being.

verses.en: Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.
verses.pt: Não confieis em príncipes, nem em filho de homem, em quem não há auxílio.
verses.en_web: Don’t put your trust in princes, each a son of man in whom there is no help.
verses.en_bbe: Put not your faith in rulers, or in the son of man, in whom there is no salvation.

verses.en: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.
verses.pt: Sai-lhe o espírito, e ele volta para a terra; naquele mesmo dia perecem os seus pensamentos.
verses.en_web: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.
verses.en_bbe: Man's breath goes out, he is turned back again to dust; in that day all his purposes come to an end.

verses.en: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD his God:
verses.pt: Bem-aventurado aquele que tem o Deus de Jacó por seu auxílio, e cuja esperança está no Senhor seu Deus
verses.en_web: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in Yahweh, his God:
verses.en_bbe: Happy is the man who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the Lord his God:

verses.en: Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein is: which keepeth truth for ever:
verses.pt: que fez os céus e a terra, o mar e tudo quanto neles há, e que guarda a verdade para sempre;
verses.en_web: who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;
verses.en_bbe: Who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all things in them; who keeps faith for ever:

verses.en: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which giveth food to the hungry. The LORD looseth the prisoners:
verses.pt: que faz justiça aos oprimidos, que dá pão aos famintos. O Senhor solta os encarcerados;
verses.en_web: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. Yahweh frees the prisoners.
verses.en_bbe: Who gives their rights to those who are crushed down; and gives food to those who are in need of it: the Lord makes the prisoners free;

verses.en: The LORD openeth the eyes of the blind: the LORD raiseth them that are bowed down: the LORD loveth the righteous:
verses.pt: o Senhor abre os olhos aos cegos; o Senhor levanta os abatidos; o Senhor ama os justos.
verses.en_web: Yahweh opens the eyes of the blind. Yahweh raises up those who are bowed down. Yahweh loves the righteous.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord makes open the eyes of the blind; the Lord is the lifter up of those who are bent down; the Lord is a lover of the upright;

verses.en: The LORD preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.
verses.pt: O Senhor preserva os peregrinos; ampara o órfão e a viúva; mas transtorna o caminho dos ímpios.
verses.en_web: Yahweh preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but the way of the wicked he turns upside down.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord takes care of those who are in a strange land; he gives help to the widow and to the child who has no father; but he sends destruction on the way of sinners.

verses.en: The LORD shall reign for ever, even thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.pt: O Senhor reinará eternamente: o teu Deus, ó Sião, reinará por todas as gerações. Louvai ao Senhor!
verses.en_web: Yahweh will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise Yah!
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will be King for ever; your God, O Zion, will be King through all generations. Praise be to the Lord.
